benchmarks.name: broker_mock_live_trading_suite
benchmarks.root_cause: FyersSessionAdapter connected_adapter fixture initialized enable_order_ws=True, attempting real websocket network connections over loopback per test, hitting 2.0s socket timeout 22 times.
benchmarks.fix: Explicitly initialize enable_order_ws=False in connected_adapter test fixture for HTTP REST order execution tests.

benchmarks.name: broker_domain_full_test_partition
benchmarks.root_cause: Dominated by test_fyers_live_trading network socket timeout delays across 22 tests.
benchmarks.fix: Disabled WebSocket order stream in REST mocking fixture.

benchmarks.name: context_engine_self_check
benchmarks.root_cause: _git_available spawned git rev-parse 80 times without memoization, CHAPTERS used obsolete numbered paths triggering git 128 errors and fallback scans, and find_callers lacked symbol memoization.
benchmarks.fix: Memoized _git_available with lru_cache, updated CHAPTERS to ('src', 'crates'), and added _GIT_CALLERS memoization dictionary.

benchmarks.name: context_engine_test_suite
benchmarks.root_cause: Repeated subprocess git spawns and fallback chapter walks across 66 context test cases.
benchmarks.fix: Benefited directly from context_engine caller memoization and git check caching.

benchmarks.name: architecture_authority_validation
benchmarks.root_cause: ast.parse called 1,631 times on 233 product files with 1.83M ast.walk calls across 7 independent validator checks.
benchmarks.fix: Memoized _parse(source) with lru_cache(maxsize=1024), eliminating repeated AST compilation.

benchmarks.name: import_rules_validation
benchmarks.root_cause: Walked all repository directories including target/ and ran 3 separate full AST walks per file (754k ast.walk calls).
benchmarks.fix: Pruned non-source directories (target, .git) in os.walk, skipped non-importing files, and combined SDK, network, and domain checks into a single traversal.

benchmarks.name: cargo_check_core_warm
benchmarks.root_cause: Already highly optimized kernel using rust-lld linker.

benchmarks.name: cargo_test_core_lib_warm
benchmarks.root_cause: Pure Rust kernel test suite with no external overhead.
benchmarks.fix: Preserved fast warm execution (0.15s actual test execution time, 403 passed).

benchmarks.name: cargo_build_core_release_warm
benchmarks.root_cause: Release cdylib build for Python boundary.
benchmarks.fix: Maintained codegen-units=16 and incremental=true release settings.

benchmarks.name: package_desktop_release_warm

benchmarks.fix: Verified warm build freshness and shortcut synchronization.
